events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Spirit
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: 49 years since the King left the building. Elvis Presley's music and legacy continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, rap icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: 30 years since the hip-hop world lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture is still felt today. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Genius
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the world lost a guitar genius. Jimi Hendrix's innovative sound continues to shape music today. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The iconic zebra crossing... the legendary tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album changed everything. What's your favourite moment from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders, what's your favourite track from the trailblazing frontwoman?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo smash?

events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single "Imagine" in 1971.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: More than just a song, it's a message. John Lennon's 'Imagine' continues to resonate around the world. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple announced its revolutionary first iPod on October 23, 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember loading up your first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you put on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's enduring legacy. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Monty Python Legend
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Musical Exploration
angles.copy: From 'Back in the U.S.S.R.' to 'Revolution 9', The Beatles' 'White Album' was a masterpiece of musical exploration. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Incomparable Showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his showmanship, his legacy... truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song?
